summary: ON DUAL REAR WHEELS MANUFACTURED BY CUSTOM AND COMMERICAL WHEELS, THE WELD BETWEEN THE CENTER DISK AND THE RIM MAY CRACK.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (32 affected)
summary: IMPROPER SIZE REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLIES WERE INSTALLED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS: (859 affected)
summary: INCORRECT GRADE 5 BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN USED TO INSTALL THE FRONT SPRING FRONT PIN CAP, INSTEAD OF THE GRADE 8 REQUIRED.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES:LOCKS:DOOR (20,096 affected)
summary: DRIVERS SIDE POWER DOOR LOCK SWITCH MAY SEPARATE DURING ACTUATION, EXPOSING THE ELECTRICAL TERMINAL.

title: Bridgestone Americas Tire Operations: TIRES (2,445 affected)
summary: THE SPITFIRE S55 TOWING RADIAL TIRES CAUSES, WOBBLING, WANDERING, AND WEAVING ON MOTORCYCLES WITH HEAVY LOADS AND SPEED.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS (56,783 affected)
summary: THE TWILIGHT SENTINEL POTENTIOMETER (THUMBWHEEL CONTROL) MIGHT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH ELECTRICAL CONTACTS WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN INTERMITTENT HEADLIGHT CIRCUIT.

title: AM GENERAL LLC: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (5,645 affected)
summary: VACUUM HARNESS ASSEMBLY HOSES BECOME LOOSE AND CAN CONTACT ENGINE EXHAUST PORTS.  CONTACT WITH EXHAUST EXPOSES HOSES TO HIGH TEMPERATURE WHICH CAUSES CARBONIZATION OF THE HOSES MATERIAL.

title: Gulf Stream Coach, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (533 affected)
summary: STEEL STRAP USED TO FASTEN ALUMINUM FUEL TANKS FAILED TO PROPERLY MAINTAIN THE TANK.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83) (34,000 affected)
summary: SPEED CONTROL SYSTEM CABLES MAY PARTIALLY DISENGAGE AND BIND AT THE CARBURETOR THROTTLE LEVER ATTACHMENT.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (339 affected)
summary: FUEL TANK FILLER NECK PIPE MAY NOT SEAT PROPERLY IN THE FUEL TANK OPENING.  ALSO, THE SENDING UNIT COVER MAY BE DEFORMED.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (15,500 affected)
summary: USAGE OF FUEL WITH REID PRESSURE UP TO 14 PSI COULD, UNDER HIGH ENGINE LOAD AND HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES, LEAD TO STALLING.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (278,520 affected)
summary: FUEL PUMP, LOCATED INSIDE FUEL TANK, COULD SEIZE DURING HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES BECAUSE OF AN EXTREME FINE MESH FUEL FILTER RESTRICTING THE FUEL FLOW.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (240 affected)
summary: BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY USED IN RIGHT HAND STATION MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY WELDED AND COULD FAIL.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (15,078 affected)
summary: FUEL HOSES (5) IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD DETERIORATE OVER TIME.

title: ACCURIDE CORPORATION: WHEELS:RIM BASE (1,046 affected)
summary: WHEEL WHICH CONSISTS OF TWO SEPARATE PARTS, A DISC AND RIM ARE WELDED TOGETHER TO FORM THE FINISH ASSEMBLY.  THE WHEELS CONTAIN AN INAPPROPRIATE ANGLE OF THE ASSEMBLY WELD, WHICH MAY CRACK AND PROGRESS THROUGH THE RIM.

title: EXECUTIVE IND., INC.: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS (78 affected)
summary: HEADLIGHT CIRCUIT BREAKER MAY FAIL WHEN ALL FOUR HEADLIGHTS ARE ON BECAUSE OF EXCESSIVE AMPERAGE DRAW.

title: WORLDWIDE TRADING CO, INC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (30,000 affected)
summary: THE PRESS BUTTON IN THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY IS LONGER DUE TO WORN TOOLING THAT STAMPS OR PUNCHES THE METAL PARTS.  THE LONGER BUTTON CAUSES THE LATCH WHICH HOLDS THE TONGUE TO DEPRESS AND NOT MAKE FULL CONTACT WITH THE TONGUE.

title: UD Trucks Corporation: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (82 affected)
summary: THE TRAILER LIGHT CORD IS WIRED SO THAT WHEN LEFT TURN SIGNAL IS FLASHING ON THE TRAILER, THE RIGHT TURN SIGNAL WILL FLASH.  ALSO, WHEN SWITCH FOR TAIL LIGHT AND LICENSE PLATE LIGHT ARE TURNED ON, THE MARKER LIGHTS BURN.

summary: INCORRECT CENTER OF GRAVITY.

title: PERRIS VALLEY CAMPERS: EQUIPMENT:CENTER OF GRAVITY INDICATOR LABEL (42 affected)
summary: INCORRECT CENTER OF GRAVITY.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: WHEELS:RIM BASE (2,349 affected)
summary: TWO PIECE ALUMINUM WHEELS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN WELDED AT POINT WHERE WHEEL IS PRESS FITTED ONTO THE RIM.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HANGER:BRACKET (14 affected)
summary: INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE BRAKE SLACK ADJUSTER AND THE AXLE HANGER BRACKET ON THE FORWARD DRIVE AXLE MAY PREVENT FULL BRAKE APPLICATION ON THAT AXLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (2,060 affected)
summary: DIESEL ENGINE GOVEERNOR LEVER ASSEMBLIES MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED SO THAT ONE OR MORE OF THREE RETAINING PRONGS MAY NOT BE ENGAGED IN THE GOVERNOR LEVER PIVOT SHAFTS.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (350 affected)
summary: LUG NUTS COULD GALL AND POSSIBLY SEIZE ON THE WHEEL STUDS WITHOUT PROVIDING ADEQUATE CLAMPING LOAD ON THE WHEELS.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING HANGER:BRA (776 affected)
summary: THE SPRING HANGER BRACKET MAY CONTAIN INCORRECT WELDS.
